REFERENCE_NUMBER_PATTERN at ReferenceNumberGenerator.java:20; CROCKFORD_BASE32 alphabet excludes I, L, O, U; length 6.
Loop of MAX_REF_RETRIES=3 attempts catching DuplicateKeyException then IllegalStateException (lines 456-473). Three attempts in total.
@Pattern on every path-variable referenceNumber in NotificationController under @Validated; ConstraintViolationException handler returns 400.
All sixteen fields present in NotificationBase (exitDate is a LocalDate at the end, not in the quote but present in the file).
Origin.java has exactly those five String fields.
Commodity has name and commodityComplement list; CommodityComplement has the four stated fields.
Species.java fields match the quote.
AnimalIdentifier fields microchip, passport, tattoo, earTag, horseName, permanentAddress (ConsignmentParty); javadoc says every unit, not just the first.

Javadoc at ConsignmentParty.java:12 says exactly this.
Address.java fields as quoted; javadoc lines 13-14 name the removed addressLine3, city and free-text country and cite cv-011 for the ISO alpha-2 code.
Transport.java fields match the quote.
MeansOfTransport enum: AIRPLANE, RAILWAY, ROAD_VEHICLE, VESSEL.
Transporter.java fields match.

NotificationBase javadoc line 45 states the LocalDate/YYYY-MM-DD/string-in-Mongo rule; exitDate and arrivalDate are LocalDate, created is Instant. Document date of issue is a LocalDate in DocumentUploadRequest.
GlobalExceptionHandler.handleUnreadableRequestBody returns 400 titled Malformed Request with that detail text.
Only @Valid @NotNull on SaveNotificationDto.notification; grep of @NotNull/@Size/@Pattern across src/main finds no constraints on any notification content type. Inference is sound.
NotificationAggregate.java:66 javadoc quoted; fulfilments is List<Document>; the rehydrate endpoint exists.

replace() lines 106-109 and updateNotification both require DRAFT or AMEND and throw BadRequestException otherwise. Quote is from the PUT path; POST-with-reference throws 'Cannot save notification with status' with the same rule.
Both replace and update throw BadRequest when concurrencyToken is null; OptimisticLockingFailureException handler returns 409 titled Stale Concurrency Token.
submitNotification accepts DRAFT or AMEND only; writeWithOutbox sets submittedAt for submission events; no completeness check in the method.
amendNotification requires SUBMITTED, deep-clones the content and fulfilments into preAmend fields, moves to AMEND.
cancelAmendNotification lines 243-275: requires AMEND and a snapshot, restores both, nulls snapshots, status SUBMITTED, comment says submittedAt is not reset.
writeWithOutbox lines 284-292: snapshots cleared when a submission event fires from AMEND; submittedAt reset to now for submission events.
copyNotification lines 121-146: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AMEND only (400); a moved-on token throws OptimisticLockingFailureException which maps to 409.

NotificationCopyMapper retains origin (country, subdivision, requiresRegion, regionOfOrigin), commodity name and type, reasonForImport, certifiedFor, five parties, cph, purpose, destination country, portOfExit and fulfilments.
Mapper omits transport, consignment, exitDate, origin internalReference, unweanedAnimals; complements keep only typeOfCommodity.
Copy calls createNotification which generates a new reference number and writes a Created event; no link to the source is stored. Inference sound.
softDeleteNotification: DELETED returns unchanged (idempotent comment), DRAFT/SUBMITTED/AMEND allowed, Deleted vs SubmissionDeleted by prior status.
Soft delete only changes status; findAll restricts to DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AMEND so DELETED rows are excluded. Inference sound.

Controller DELETE /notifications returns 400 on empty list and requires trace and User-Id headers; AdminSecretFilter guards it; service 404s on any missing reference, cascades to documents, writes audit on failure and success. Quote is in the service at line 393 (ref line loose).
stampExpiry skips when days null or prod; deleteExpired and the sweeper (enabled flag default false in application.yml, prod-safe) hard-delete with documents.
Gap holds: grep -rli template across src/main only hits infrastructure and upload classes (HTTP/Mongo templates), none a notification template; no template status, endpoint or entity.

GET /notifications is paged from 1 (@Min(1)), page size 25 in application.yml, NotificationView exposes exactly those fields. Cited quote is the controller sort description, so ref is loose, but the statement is right.

NotificationSort.toSort: arrivalDate and createdAt with asc or any other direction as desc; null, blank, malformed or unknown field fall to arrivalDate desc. Note an unrecognised direction word falls to desc rather than default, which does not contradict the claim.
findAll trims the reference and does an exact match among dashboard statuses, empty page otherwise; the controller takes no other filter parameter.
NotificationFulfilmentsView has those getters and the controller maps 404 via NotFoundException.
Gap holds: NotificationAggregate has no owner, user or organisation field; findAll takes no caller identity and lists all DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AMEND rows.
writeWithOutbox appends an event in the same write; OutboxPublishService.publishToSns uses aggregateId as group and eventId as de-duplication id.
OutboxEventType has the eight types with prefix uk.gov.defra.imports.notification. and schema URLs in DEFRA/trade-imports-schemas.
Event selection matches createNotification, updateNotification/replace (Edited), submitNotification, amend, cancelAmend and softDelete code.
NO_VERSION_ID_EVENTS = Created, Edited, Deleted; computeVersionId returns count+1 for submission events, else the count.
Actor.java has the six fields; OutboxService builds statusChanges with date and actor on each status change; actor is optional (resolveActor may return null).

GbnAgEventData.MODEL_VALUE is defra/certificate-internal/1; ExchangedDocument carries identifier, traderAssignedId, status code, versionId, issueDateTime from updated, and references only COMPLETE documents.
SpecifiedConsignment record maps the parties, carrier, origin country, unloading base port, CPH as final destination, movements, transit countries, unweaned flag and items as stated.
SpecifiedConsignment: null when additionalDetails or unweanedAnimals is null, otherwise Boolean.valueOf. Note any non-'true' string publishes false.
GET outbox-events and POST replay exist; replay requires User-Id header and the filter requires the admin secret for POST replay; controller description says read-only.

AdminSecretFilter applies only to DELETE /notifications* and POST /notifications/*/replay and returns 401 on missing or wrong secret. Other endpoints are unfiltered at this service, though Swagger text lists 401 on some.
DocumentUploadRequest constraints as stated; DocumentType has exactly 14 values as listed.
DocumentService: pending session via cdp-uploader, proxyFileToUploader, scan callback resolveScanStatus is fail-closed (COMPLETE only when rejected count is 0).

application.yml cdp.uploader max-file-size 52428800 and the mime list (pdf, word, jpeg, png, excel); DocumentService line 66 permits multiple PENDING documents; download of a rejected file throws NotFound. The 50 MB and mime values are env-overridable defaults.
DocumentController.java:157 security note says the callback is unauthenticated; the document endpoints take only an id or reference with no owner check.
GlobalExceptionHandler produces ProblemDetail with title, detail, type, traceId and errors map for validation; 400, 404, 409, 413, 502 and 500 handlers all present.

Gap holds: the handler returns bean-validation default messages keyed by field, and no user-facing per-field messages are authored in the backend. The conclusion about the frontend is a reasonable inference.
